item.title: Differentiating Westerly and Asian monsoon dust fluxes to the tropical Pacific Ocean since the late Pliocene
item.content:encoded:
Communications Earth & Environment, Published online: 26 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s43247-026-04172-w

“Ecological conditions of dust source regions exert an impact on dust flux and thus on the tropical ocean, shown using grain size modeling and geochemical fingerprinting of a 4-million-year-long sediment record from the Philippine Sea”
